headline: Pakistan Adjusts Petrol Price by Re1 per Litre While Diesel Unchanged
summary: The Pakistan government reduced the petrol price by Re1 to Rs323 per litre while keeping high-speed diesel unchanged at Rs355 per litre following an OGRA notification.
why: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) sets fortnightly domestic fuel price revisions in Pakistan according to international oil benchmark movements.
